tasks.task: Make a carousel or a set of social posts

items.when: When you need exact sizes, type and safe areas for each post
Before you settle a layout, to get three hand-made alternatives
When the slides must tell one story from first frame to last
When a series needs covers that look like one family
Before hand-over, to test every slide reads on a phone
When every option looks like a template
When the job is a month of posts, not one set

tasks.task: Design a poster or flyer for an event or an offer

items.when: First, to fix the one message, the reader and every word on the piece
When the poster needs one idea a passer-by gets in a second
When there are no usable photos and type must carry it
When you want a guided run from source files to a checked layout
When the layout must become a spec a printer can follow
Before hand-over, to test type size and spacing at reading distance
When the type is correct but the poster has no voice

tasks.task: Get a layout ready for the printer

items.when: When you set bleed, trim, safe area, colour mode and paper
Before a file goes to print, to catch what printers reject
When one job runs from brief to a print-ready hand-over
When someone else will build the file from your spec

tasks.task: Lay out a menu or a price list

items.when: When you plan sections, order and prices for a menu
Before layout, to set the grid, a short type list and white space
When you need a few font pairs to compare, not one guess
Before hand-over, to test it reads in dim light at arm's length

tasks.task: Plan signs for a shop, venue or event

items.when: When you list every sign with its size, words and place
When people must find their way through a space
Before hand-over, to test each sign reads from where people stand

tasks.task: Prepare artwork specs for merch and packaging

items.when: When artwork goes on shirts, mugs, bags or stickers
When the colours must carry a mood and still print well
Before hand-over, to test colour pairs with real contrast numbers

tasks.task: Set the look for a small brand: colours, type and rules

items.when: When a brand needs a few firm rules anyone can follow
When you want palettes that differ in mood, not only in hue
When you need a few font pairs to compare, not one guess
When a logo must be tested small, in one colour and at a glance
When the system has too many parts and needs cutting down
When a second pair of eyes should test the work against the brand

tasks.task: Make or edit images with an AI tool

items.when: When exporting finished media, inspect the actual files and package reproducible editable sources
When the client works in Canva and needs editable layouts
When a photo the client owns must be extended or fixed
When you want several visual worlds to choose between
Before hand-over, to test the result still looks like the brand

always.when: Before any work that must look or sound like the client
When the brief is loose and needs clear limits before you start

helpers.when: When the piece needs more copy than a headline and a line
When the job needs a new identity, not a layout inside one
When the layout depends on product photos that do not exist yet
When the posts need a calendar, captions and a plan to publish

gaps: No library item renders three poster directions as images to compare
No library item checks a finished print file against a named printer's own template
